name: SlateSave
description: One save slot for one player. A save is a whole universe, serialised. Three slots per player, and no player can ever see another player's rows.

slot.description: Which of the player's three slots this is.

save_id.description: The universe's own id. Every record inside the payload carries it, and it is what proves one save has not been mixed with another.

payload.description: The serialised universe. Opaque to the server except for the invariants checked on write.

backup_payload.description: The previous payload, kept so a bad write or an accidental delete is recoverable.

schema_version.description: Save format version. The client refuses to load a save written by a newer build than it understands.

world_now.description: The universe's clock, in epoch milliseconds. Only ever moves forward.

playtime_seconds.description: Real seconds played. Only ever moves forward.

performer_title.description: Actor, or actress. SLATE is a simulator of both, held as equals, so the title is a column of its own rather than a detail inside the payload.

premise.description: What the game this save belongs to is. Written by the client, checked by the server on every write, and stored beside the save so the database itself says what it holds.

kind.description: SLATE is an actor and actress life simulator. A row that says anything else is not stored.

statement.description: The premise in full, so a reader of the raw row needs nothing else to understand it.

equal_standing.description: Whether actor and actress stand equal in this save. Always true; a false is refused on write.

player_title.description: The title this save's player carries.

player_title_source.description: Whether the player stated their title themselves, or their pronouns implied it.

integrity.description: What the server checked when it accepted this write.

postings_balance.description: Every posting in the universe summed to zero.

save_id_consistent.description: No record inside carried a different save id.

deleted_at.description: Set when the player clears the slot. The backup is kept; nothing is destroyed outright.
